test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are A.

II. Some X are W.

**Conclusions:**

I. All X are A.

II. Some W are X.

III. Some A are not X.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2885488013cd53260d5070d55a3b3a7198f40a7e5b0bb3663534b8a9d83ae93.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All X are A → **Does not f**ollow (As some X are W, all W are A. So,it is possible but not definitely true. therefore it Does not follow)

II. Some W are X → Follow (As some X are W. So, it is definitely true)

III. Some A are not X → **Does not follow (There is any** given relation between A and X. It is possible Some X are A. And It is also possible All X are A. So, We can not define the relation. So, the conclusion is not follow )

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows****"**.
